source_behavior.purpose: Render a safe error center with Error ID, Correlation ID and error time while directing full diagnostics to server logs.
source_behavior.sensitive_detail_policy: The route page itself states that sensitive technical details are not exposed.
source_behavior.tracking_fallback: The source falls back to the current HTTP trace identifier when dedicated ErrorId/CorrelationId items are absent.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: The controller rereads request_id and correlation_id already normalized by RequestCorrelation and renders only those identifiers plus current error time. Query parameters, exception messages and stack traces are not rendered.

security_and_tenancy.adaptation: tenant-neutral route matching the source /Error surface
security_and_tenancy.reason: The canonical scanner marks the row tenant-owned, but the source route has no tenant/resource parameter or authorization attribute and its diagnostic payload is request-local rather than tenant data.
proof: RequestCorrelation accepts only bounded identifier characters and generates a UUID when caller identifiers are invalid.
The Blade view uses escaped interpolation and never consumes query-string exception/error payloads.
Guest and authenticated identities receive byte-identical HTML when request IDs and time are fixed.
No tenant, user, membership or direct resource identifier appears in the route contract.

assertions: canonical operation metadata and exact /Error source identity
explicit ErrorReadController route with web-only middleware and zero parameters
invalid caller tracking headers are replaced and not reflected
query-supplied secrets/exception details are not rendered

evidence_commit_rule: This artifact records the implementation snapshot immediately before evidence. The evidence-bearing final PR head must itself pass exact-head CI before VERIFIED_TASK_COMPLETE may be declared.
